coverage: Unchanged 95% holding value / 70% names; complete 211-session raw-price/raw-volume/adjusted-close windows; 45/60-day modeled holdings lag, maximum 140-day snapshot age.
constituent_basis: Raw close times reconstructed raw share volume; adjusted close for returns. Unknown raw values stay missing. Original dated IVV membership and conservative identity-name matching retained.
etf_basis: Governed dividend/split-adjusted OHLC and original split-adjusted source volume, matching the previous strategy convention. Flow overlays remain adjusted-activity proxies, not actual raw-dollar turnover or net flows.
models: Same annual expanding causal base-tree recipe; residual joint and price trees refitted only on completed labels. Actual deployed frozen model only used after 2023. No parameter tuning.
comparison: Same 2016-01-04 through 2026-09-24 interval and frozen legacy FX. Compare old native evidence, corrected ETF inputs with old features, and corrected ETF plus corrected stock features. Price-only controls match availability. Costs/delay identical.
scatter: Raw and EMA10 HHI, first and second backward differences (1 and 10 sessions), against 20/60/120-session adjusted SPY and fixed-cohort constituent returns. Same 120-session-complete dates across horizons. A constituent return is unavailable if any selected stock endpoint is missing; no forward survivor reweighting.
inference: Exploratory reused data, zero-hurdle Sharpe, paired active IR; annual and 2016-19/2020-22/2023+ periods; paired 63/126-session blocks and max-t across declared candidates. Scatter Pearson/Spearman and 240-session block intervals; nonoverlap offsets and chronological-period checks.
limitations: Revised provider prices and uncertified issuer episodes; historical publication lags assumed; IVV is an SPY same-index proxy, not all-market census. Legacy FX reused with max7-day prior carry; adjusted CNH units, modeled daily open fills. Auditing does not create certified historical vintages or untouched holdouts.
